title: Ruffa Gutierrez enjoys 'queenmaker' role, to support Michelle Dee in Thailand
summary: Ruffa Gutierrez has closed the door on rejoining pageantry, saying she is now more comfortable mentoring younger beauty queens, among them Michelle Dee, who will be joing the upcoming Miss Grand…

blocks.text: Ruffa Gutierrez has closed the door on rejoining pageantry, saying she is now more comfortable mentoring younger beauty queens, among them Michelle Dee, who will be joing the upcoming Miss Grand International (MGI) All Stars competition in Thailand this December 12. In a sit-down interview with reporters following the advanced screening of their new movie together, “Red Crown,” Gutierrez said she wants to pay forward the help that she had received when she herself was vying for a beauty pageant crown. “I definitely would not do that (return to pageantry) but I’m there to support them.
